Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Solstice Health — Workspace Access, Roles & API Seed Timeline

Hi Laura / Sam —

Great to meet you on Thursday. As discussed, this thread is to coordinate the initial workspace access and the API key seeding so your devs can start hitting the sandbox project next week. Proposed scope here: projects to create, role mapping for your teams, temporary API key handoff, and a short timeline for the first two sprints.

Key asks from our side:
- Please confirm the two initial projects you want seeded (e.g., "clinical-search" and "patient-summaries").
- Provide a simple role map: which Solstice AD groups should be "workspace-admin", "developer", and "viewer". I attached a template (solstice_role_map_template.xlsx) you can fill out.
- Confirm a single point of contact for procurement for the contract signature (cc'd procurement if applicable).

Proposed timeline:
- 10/07: Redwood seeds projects and creates temporary API key for sandbox (30-day TTL).
- 10/08: Joint pairing session (30–45m) to validate keys, project permissions, and example calls.
- 10/12: Production admin invites and role pinning (if procurement/contract done).

Monica and Dev are on the thread to handle the provisioning and the small pairing session. Monica will own invites; Dev will handle API key generation and sandbox routing.

Attachments: solstice_role_map_template.xlsx, redwood-onboard-invite-checklist.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting you running.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Laura Kim <laura.k@solsticehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>

Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solstice Health — Workspace Access, Roles & API Seed Timeline

Thanks Ben — this looks good. Quick answers:
- Projects: yes, please seed "clinical-search" and "patient-summaries". We also want a third sandbox namespace called "nlp-experiments" if possible.
- Role mapping: I attached a lightly populated version of your template. Summary:
  - Workspace Admins: IdentityOps group (identityops@solsticehealth.com)
  - Developers: CoreNLP Engineers (core-nlp@solsticehealth.com)
  - Viewers: Analytics (analytics@solsticehealth.com)
- Procurement: looping in procurement@solsticehealth.com for contract status (they're fast but will need DocuSign).

Are the temporary API keys scoped per-project or workspace-wide for the sandbox? We prefer per-project scoped tokens for least privilege.

Also, can you confirm the pairing session time windows on 10/08? We prefer late morning (10:30–11:30 PT).

Best,
Laura
Dir. of Applied ML | Solstice Health
laura.k@solsticehealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>

Date: 2026-10-05T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solstice Health — Workspace Access, Roles & API Seed Timeline

Thanks Laura — that's perfect. Quick notes from implementation:
- We will seed three projects: clinical-search, patient-summaries, nlp-experiments, under a Solstice org namespace.
- Temporary API keys: we can generate project-scoped tokens for the sandbox projects (recommended). Token TTL: 30 days, renewable.
- Invite flow: we'll send admin invites to IdentityOps first so they can validate RBAC mappings. I attached our invite checklist for transparency.

Ben / Dev — can you confirm who will generate the project keys and post them securely? I suggest we use the DocuSign/secure-note approach we used for Cedarbrook last quarter (see link).

Action items assigned: 
- Dev: generate project-scoped sandbox keys and update the secure note (due 10/07 EOD).
- Monica: prepare invites and coordinate admin acceptance (kickoff 10/08).
- Ben: confirm procurement contact loop and DocuSign link.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

Got the note and one-time link — thanks Dev, that worked for me. A couple follow-ups from the pairing runthrough: 

- Token scope verification: we validated that the clinical-search token cannot access patient-summaries project resources — good least-privilege behavior.
- Can you add a short TTL-rotation play (one-paragraph) to the secure note describing how to rotate the tokens and what happens to active streams? We'll need that for our security docs.
- Procurement: procurement@solsticehealth.com — I'll follow up on the DocuSign envelope this afternoon. Expect a signature by 10/08.

Thanks everyone — Monica, please send admin invites once IdentityOps confirms the RBAC mapping (we'll aim to finish role pinning on 10/12).

Best,
Laura
